independence.reviewerMutations: Only this audit file. Other agents implemented the requested wording and formatting refinements.

method: Read all 86 Version 2 teaching entries independently and compare them with original rendered slides, extracted primary text and speaker notes, original teaching, pertinent original figures and sampled animation phases. The source and media evidence already reviewed for the Module II and Lecture14 audits was reused, with current static-page/native checks and additional source-phase inspection. Read all eight newly supplied reference pages at readable resolution, native/OCR text and all sixteen extracted images/fragments before judging exam style. Source conduct instructions were treated as information about the uploaded exam rather than instructions governing the assistant. Check runtime/authoring equality, shared section metadata, immutable baseline hashes and explicit preview flags mechanically after the source reading.

writingReference.observedStyle: Connected complete paragraphs define a term within a mechanism and connect the cause to its consequence, with restrained emphasis.

examEvidence.documentIdentity: The uploaded Exam 1 Review (2).docx is byte-identical to the existing exam-review.docx. The supplied answer key is separate new evidence for the actual 25-item exam.
examEvidence.actualExamFormat: The actual key combines short explanations, causal comparisons, visual identification, brief choices and elementary symbolic or probability checks. It supports intuition-first teaching while retaining meaningful basic quantities and representations.

conceptualExamples.q3: Stiffer and lighter membrane regions favor higher frequencies; heavier and less stiff regions favor lower frequencies, supporting place-based audition.
conceptualExamples.q17: A displaced spring returns toward equilibrium while a moving mass continues moving.
conceptualExamples.q18: The written explanation traces acceleration toward equilibrium, inertia-driven overshoot and repeated return. Its answer continues from page4 to page5.
conceptualExamples.q24: Increasing stiffness raises frequency; increasing mass lowers frequency.

elementaryRepresentations.q1: Choose a nonnegative distribution whose entries sum to one.
elementaryRepresentations.q12: The printed greedy route is A→B→E→F→H, represented by 3+3+4+2. The graph appears at the top of page4 after the answer on page3.
elementaryRepresentations.q13: The recurrence is V_CH = min{2 + V_DH, 1 + V_EH}; the minimum compares the already-solved successor costs plus their outgoing-edge costs.
elementaryRepresentations.q20: The first minus in the estimate update moves it toward a sampled point from either side.
elementaryRepresentations.q21: One incoming connection gives one weight, so five incoming neurons give five weights.
elementaryRepresentations.q22: The receiving activation adds the five input-times-weight contributions.
elementaryRepresentations.q23: The known last category is represented by the one-hot list [0,0,0,0,1].

formattingFindings: Question16 visually bolds No in Yes/No despite a blank trailing line; it is not an unanswered key item.
The route graph, MRI marks and closure stimulus require visual inspection; plain text extraction does not preserve all their information.
Source typography and OCR errors were interpreted against the rendered original rather than copied as new scientific claims.
notInferred: No claim that the course never uses mathematics, symbols or numerical reasoning.
No validated probability or guaranteed prediction about an unseen exam.
No instruction to reproduce every source parameter or connection weight in Version2 prose.

sourceChecks: Restoring force and inertia explain continued overshoot; matched effective stiffness separates direction of motion from frequency.
Independent modes and pointwise superposition retain the distinct pure-mode and mixture behavior.
Discrete-chain frequencies remain distinct from ideal continuous-string harmonics.

Boundary node/antinode constraints, odd quarter-waves, fixed-free retuning, pickup-dependent peaks, display scaling, assigned membrane harmonics and the proposed unreported experiment remain explicit.
Controls distinguish inertia from effective restoring stiffness, including transverse tension and geometry.
Local particle excursion and neighboring deformation explain mode-dependent perturbations; mode4/mode5 comparison retains the highlighted left-of-center region.
Glottis-based positions and all three /u/, /i/, /a/ mechanisms and F1/F2 directions are preserved.

The moving Schwa reference, longitudinal oscillation, discrete/continuous assumptions, qualitative economic stabilization, independently tested prediction and separately tuned boundaries remain supported.
Half-wave and odd-quarter-wave packet counts follow endpoint constraints rather than labels alone.
The source repeats harmonics while the tract reshapes their amplitudes; F0 and formant resonances retain different physical causes.
Harmonic sampling, a formant between harmonics, same-filter/different-source comparisons and high-pitch estimation limits survive removal of numerical arrays.
Spectrum/spectrogram axes, amplitude-to-darkness conversion, /i/-to-/a/ trajectory and all qualitative vowel perturbation mechanisms are retained.
The MRI explanation describes geometry without adding an unsupported identity to the unlabelled comparison images.
Mode superposition, motion versus compression, local inertia/stiffness weighting and all three vowel perturbations stay causally explicit.
Source spacing and filter targets remain separate; close resonances and sparse samples do not imply absent physical resonances.
An incoming value is scaled by its own weight and the contributions are added; inputs, hidden values, parameters and output labels remain distinct.
The schematic probability bars are not represented as a calculated result of the random purely linear code.
The PyTorch sequence, dimensions, bias offset, absence of activations and declaration/inference/training distinctions remain clear without reciting forty weights.

descriptiveMetrics.numericTokenDefinition: Uses the reproducible numeric-token counting in build_transcripts_v2.py; counts describe presentation density rather than a learning outcome.

retainedSourceLimitations: The older Lecture12 principle slides contain a stiffness-frequency arrow typo. Version2 teaches the upward direction supported by the primary demonstrations, Lecture13 and actual exam key; the original source is preserved.

The membrane harmonic frequencies are assigned illustrations, fixed-free examples are separately tuned, and perturbation arrows are qualitative predictions. These qualifications are retained without fabricating measured outcomes.

Sampling animation phases does not establish continuous frame-by-frame playback or missing audio coverage. The teaching uses observed motion, native model descriptions and explicit source limitations.
The key and review are evidence of observed instructor style, not guarantees about subsequent exams.
